summary: Harden scanner capture recovery and QR corruption tests
description: Follow-up from TKT-30 review. Surface `BarcodeDetector.detect()` runtime failures to the gate operator and return them to the paste path; add a deterministic QR signature-corruption helper/assertion rather than mutating the final base64url character, whose unused bits can occasionally decode to unchanged bytes. Keep this out of TKT-30’s reviewed PR.

binding.rule: Redemption correctness stays server-side; scanner UI must communicate a recoverable camera failure without changing lifecycle behavior.
